pages.text: The $(d)Claws$() Gene adds 4 hearts of unarmed damage and a 33% chance to inflict Bleeding on empty-handed hits.$(br2)Claws II adds another 4 hearts and raises the Bleeding chance to 66%. Bleeding deals half a heart each second.$(br2)This Gene $(9)can be given to mobs$().
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)3/16 - Polar Bear
